templates.name: Resource Hoarder
templates.description: Survivor quietly skims dry rations, copper wire, and battery cells into a concealed stash inside an abandoned maintenance shaft.
clue_descriptions: Unaccounted inventory discrepancies detected during weekly supply audit.
Grease smudges and boot prints found leading behind decommissioned generator casing.
Survivor noticed lingering nervously near the secondary supply depot after shift change.

templates.name: PRPF Radio Informant
templates.description: Survivor maintains a covert shortwave transmitter, transmitting patrol routines and food reserves to PRPF forward scouts.
clue_descriptions: Unregistered radio frequency transmission burst logged on emergency monitoring coil.
Coded coordinate cipher discovered tucked inside a torn ventilation manual.
Survivor observed mapping external sentry rotation intervals during dusk watch.

templates.name: Rebel Sympathizer
templates.description: Survivor distributes underground rebel manifestos, attempting to ferment discontent against shelter authority.
clue_descriptions: Hand-inked rebel slogans found stamped on washroom ductwork.
Survivor overheard arguing passionately against ration quotas during meal gathering.
Chalk markings found highlighting blind spots in internal security sweeps.

templates.name: Ventilation Saboteur
templates.description: Survivor systematically loosens scrubber coupling brackets, accelerating filter degradation to create panic.
clue_descriptions: Fresh tool abrasions discovered on secondary air intake housing bolts.
Chemical residue consistent with corrosive degreaser detected in water trap.
Survivor clocked leaving mechanical service corridor without scheduled maintenance slip.

templates.name: Wasteland Deserter
templates.description: Survivor plans to breach the outer airlock under cover of an upcoming dust storm, taking survival gear.
clue_descriptions: Emergency water purification tablets missing from infirmary back room.
Crude trail map sketch found concealed inside a hollowed book spine.
Survivor inquiring intensely about vehicle battery charge levels and exterior rad levels.

templates.name: Secret Relic Custodian
templates.description: Survivor guards an uncatalogued pre-war archival drive, terrified that shelter council will destroy or misuse it.
clue_descriptions: Survivor guards personal footlocker with irrational hostility during routine checks.
Anomalous optical drive hum heard late at night in sleeping quarters.
Furtive hushed conversations noted whenever pre-war history or technology is discussed.
